name: Johto & Sevii Arena Rematches
summary: Track the 8 Johto and Sevii Gym Leaders across their overworld retreats: Whitney visiting Goldenrod Department Store, Kurt gathering Apricorns in Slowpoke Well, Falkner observing from Violet Spire, Morty contemplating Bell Tower, Pryce at Lake of Rage, Clair training in Dragon's Den, Chuck sparring on Boon Island beach, and Jasmine tending Kin Island Lighthouse. Challenge each to fierce 6 vs 6 competitive rematches (Levels 82 to 86) inside the Vermilion Arena. Defeating all 16 Gym Leaders across both regional leagues completes the Grand Rematch circuit and unlocks Tier 4 and Tier 5 Elite Four Rematches.
